text_models.note: type=text is synchronous: POST /generate returns the answer in the same response, no polling. Billing is per actual tokens — a reserve is held by max_tokens and the unused part is refunded immediately, in the same call. Free dry run: POST /generate/estimate with type=text returns the reserve and the per-1M rates.

flow: 1. GET /me — confirm the key works and check daily_spend_limit.
4. POST /upload-media — upload media and get a stable URL.

seedream-5-pro.price_note: price = цена при quality по умолчанию; все варианты — в price_by_quality

gemini-omni-character.description: Gemini Omni — консистентный персонаж из 1 фото + описания. Возвращает изображение персонажа; characterId из result_object переиспользуется в gemini-omni-video → character_ids.
gemini-omni-character.hint: prompt = описание персонажа или поле descriptions. image_urls: ровно 1 стабильный URL, используйте POST /api/agent/upload-media. characterId берите из GET /generation/{id}/status.

gemini-omni-video.description: Google Gemini Omni (движок Veo 3) — text/image/video-to-video с нативным синхронным звуком. Кастомный голос передаётся только через персонажа.
gemini-omni-video.hint: duration = 4|6|8|10. image_urls до 7 → image-to-video. video_list: [{url,start,ends}] → video-to-video, 1 клип, отрезок ≤10с. Не передавайте audio_ids напрямую в video: создайте gemini-omni-character с audio_ids и передайте character_ids.

grok-ttv.price_note: price = цена при дефолтных параметрах; итог зависит от duration/тира — сверяйтесь с tier_prices или POST /generate/estimate

grok-itv.price_note: price = цена при дефолтных параметрах; итог зависит от duration/тира — сверяйтесь с tier_prices или POST /generate/estimate
grok-itv.hint: image_urls: exactly 1 stable URL. Use POST /api/agent/upload-media.

gemini-flash-tts.description: Google Gemini 3.1 Flash TTS — fast, expressive text-to-speech and multi-speaker dialogue. Price per-character: 13₽ per started 1000 chars.
gemini-flash-tts.note: Single voice: pass prompt + optional voice_name (one of voices, default Zephyr) + style. Control emotion with inline tags in the text, e.g. "[cheerfully] Hello! [whispering] a secret". Dialogue: pass speakers[] and dialogue_turns[] (see dialogue_format). temperature 0-2 = liveliness. scene/sample_context set atmosphere and tone.

gemini-pro-tts.description: Google Gemini 2.5 Pro TTS — studio-quality, high-fidelity text-to-speech and dialogue. Price per-character: 18₽ per started 1000 chars.
gemini-pro-tts.note: Same params as gemini-flash-tts, premium studio quality. Single voice: prompt + voice_name + style + inline emotion tags. Dialogue: speakers[] + dialogue_turns[].

dialogue_turns.text: [warmly] And it is a big one.

el-tts-turbo.description: ElevenLabs TTS Turbo 2.5 — fast text-to-speech. Price is per-character: 6₽ per started 1000 chars.
el-tts-turbo.note: voice_id accepts either a name or an ElevenLabs voice ID. See GET /api/agent/voices. Long texts: prompt over 5000 chars (up to 200000) is automatically processed as a long voiceover — split into ~4800-char chunks, voiced and merged into one mp3; /generate then returns voiceover_id + status_url (GET /api/agent/voiceover/long/{id}) instead of generation_id. Same per-character price, refunded on failure.

el-tts-multilingual-v2.description: ElevenLabs TTS Multilingual V2 — high-quality multi-language speech
el-tts-multilingual-v2.note: Higher quality than turbo; supports previous_text/next_text for speech continuity.

el-dialogue-v3.description: ElevenLabs Dialogue v3 multi-speaker conversational audio
el-dialogue-v3.note: For multi-speaker dialogue pass dialogue[] with voice_id per line. If omitted, a single-speaker dialogue is built from prompt.

el-sound-fx-v2.description: ElevenLabs Sound FX v2 — generate sound effects from text description
el-sound-fx-v2.note: Describe the sound effect. duration_seconds defaults to 5s, prompt_influence defaults to 0.5.

gemini-omni-audio.description: Gemini Omni — кастомный голос-ассет. Возвращает audioId в result_object; аудиофайл не возвращается.
gemini-omni-audio.hint: prompt = название голоса. audio_id — базовый пресет, по умолчанию achernar. audioId используйте в gemini-omni-character через audio_ids, а затем персонажа в video через character_ids.

suno-v5.5.description: Suno V5.5 next-gen AI music with vocals
suno-v5.5.note: Latest Suno model with improved vocal quality and style adherence. persona_id can be a custom voice.

claude-opus-5.description: Claude Opus 5 — synchronous text generation, billed per actual tokens
claude-opus-5.hint: Answer comes back in the same response (no polling). Price is charged per actual tokens: 1500₽ per 1M input, 7500₽ per 1M output, minimum 2₽ per call. A reserve is held by max_tokens and the unused part is refunded immediately. thinking=true turns on reasoning (better on hard tasks, costs output tokens); it is off by default.

features.pre_charge_validation: Media URL params are HEAD-checked before any debit. Bad URL returns HTTP 422 media_validation_failed, no charge.
features.webhook_delivery: Pass callback_url in /generate. We POST generation.complete or generation.error with X-Vibe-Signature HMAC. Test with POST /api/agent/webhook-test.
features.strict_mode: Pass strict=true to reject unknown/incompatible params before debit. Without strict they are reported as ignored_params.
features.dry_run: POST /generate/estimate validates and prices a request without spending money.
features.auto_refund_on_error: If provider or pipeline fails after start, the generation cost is refunded automatically.
features.persistence: Generation continues server-side even if polling stops.

brand.note: Brand Voice: store brand profiles (tone, palette, voice, defaults) and pass brand_id to /generate — brand fields are injected only where the model schema allows, user params always win, price-affecting params are never injected. Set an active brand via POST /brand/activate to apply it to every generation without passing brand_id. Opt out per-request with brand_apply=false.

endpoints.GET /api/agent/brands: List brand profiles with products and active pair (scope: read).
endpoints.POST /api/agent/brand: Create or update (pass id) a brand profile — free (scope: write).
endpoints.POST /api/agent/brand/{id}/product: Create or update (pass id) a product/service (scope: write).
endpoints.POST /api/agent/brand/activate: {brand_id, product_id} — set active pair; nulls switch it off (scope: write).

generate_params.brand_id: Apply this brand profile to the generation (must be yours, otherwise 422 brand_not_found before any debit).
generate_params.product_id: Optional product of the same brand for context.
generate_params.brand_apply: false disables injection even when an active brand is set.

brand.estimate: POST /generate/estimate with brand_id returns applied_brand_fields[] — exactly what will be injected, free of charge.

upload_endpoint.returns: JSON with stable URL for image_urls, reference_*_urls, first_frame_url, etc.

music_params.persona_id: (optional) Custom voice ID from POST /api/agent/voice/validate workflow

suno_voice_workflow.description: Create a custom voice clone for use in Suno music generation. Voices have limited validity period; check status/list before use.
steps: 1. POST /api/agent/voice/validate — submit source audio URL + vocal segment. Returns task_id.
2. GET /api/agent/voice/validate-info?task_id=... — poll until verification phrase is ready.
3. Record the user reading the phrase and upload it via POST /api/agent/upload-media.
4. POST /api/agent/voice/generate — submit task_id + verify_url. Returns new task_id.
5. GET /api/agent/voice/status?task_id=... — poll until voice_id is ready.
6. Use voice_id as persona_id in POST /api/agent/generate with type=music and model=suno-v5 or suno-v5.5.
suno_voice_workflow.regenerate: If the validation phrase expired: POST /api/agent/voice/regenerate.

endpoints.POST /api/agent/generate: Start generation. Pass strict=true to reject bad params before debit.
endpoints.POST /api/agent/generate/estimate: Dry-run: validate + price a /generate body without spending
endpoints.POST /api/agent/webhook-test: Send a signed test event to callback_url
endpoints.POST /api/agent/upload-media: Upload a file, get a stable URL
endpoints.GET /api/agent/voiceover/long/{id}: Long voiceover (el-tts-turbo, prompt > 5000 chars) progress and result
endpoints.POST /api/agent/voice/validate: Suno Voice: submit source audio for custom voice creation
endpoints.POST /api/agent/voice/generate: Suno Voice: submit recorded verification audio
endpoints.GET /api/agent/voice/status: Suno Voice: check voice creation status
endpoints.POST /api/agent/voice/regenerate: Suno Voice: regenerate expired verification phrase
